q: How much do office vending machines add to our emissions?
title: Office vending machine emissions
short: A refrigerated vending machine runs day and night, so it uses more electricity than its size suggests. Count its units at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, from a plug meter or its rated consumption, labelled as an estimate. Timers on lighting and cooling cut it.

ul: Your power bill, your machine: Scope 2.
Vendor's machine on your power: still your Scope 2.

p: Switch off the display lights at night and pick machines with efficient compressors.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
